extraction.document_summary: AIA Beyond Critical Care is a critical illness (CI) protection plan with multistage CI coverage, relapse protection, and additional benefits for mental well-being. Under the base plan, it covers 43 major stage critical illnesses and 5 rediagnosed or recurred critical illnesses, paying 100% of the coverage amount as a lump sum upon first diagnosis, with the coverage amount restored to 100% after 12 months (subject to the rules on same vs different rediagnosed/recurred events). It also adds mental well-being benefit for 5 mental illnesses, paying an additional 20% of the coverage amount (up to S$50,000 per claim) until age 75, with up to 5 claims (S$150,000 total across all policies). The plan includes a 100% premium refund at policy expiry (base plan total annual premiums, less claims and amounts owing), but exclusions apply for pre-existing conditions and the brochure notes waiting and survival periods before benefits are payable.
quality_notes: Brochure clearly states many core benefit mechanics (payout percentages, coverage counts, refund mechanics, and several caps).
Specific rider product summary details (full CI lists/definitions under each rider) are not provided in this excerpt; only rider names and some waiver mechanics are stated.
Waiting/survival periods are mentioned generally, but exact durations for each benefit are not consistently specified in the excerpt.

policies.quick_summary: Base plan covers major stage critical illnesses and relapse (including rediagnosed/recurrred events), provides a 100% premium refund at policy expiry (less claims), pays an additional mental well-being amount for covered mental illnesses, and includes death, compassionate, and health screening reimbursement benefits. Riders mentioned include multistage CI cover extra and premium waiver/payor benefits triggered by specified CI/mental illness events (details vary by rider). Pre-existing conditions are excluded; waiting and survival periods apply before benefits are payable; some coverage restoration/claim rules depend on whether the subsequent claim is the same or different event.
coverage_scope: Rediagnosed or recurred critical illness (5 specified)
Relapse protection (coverage amount restoration and subsequent claim rules)
Mental illnesses (5 prominent mental illnesses; additional 20% benefit)
policies.coverage_term_description: The brochure states the policy terminates at age 85 (and the example illustrates termination at age 85). Mental well-being is until age 75.
policy_termination_events: Policy expiry / termination at age 85 (as illustrated)
Policy terminates upon the insured's death (death benefit note)
important_caveats: The brochure states there are exclusions such as pre-existing conditions, and waiting period and survival period apply before benefits are payable.
Angioplasty and other invasive treatments for Coronary Artery: the brochure states the benefit excludes this item, and only 10% of the coverage amount up to S$25,000 is payable.

Coverage amount restoration and subsequent claim eligibility depend on whether the subsequent critical illness is a different critical illness or one of the 5 rediagnosed/recurred critical illnesses, and includes waiting between diagnoses for certain same-event subsequent claims.
The refund of premiums is the base plan’s total annual premiums (less any claims paid), including waived premiums with optional premium waiver rider.
